theme: Workflow Runtime Cleanup and Guard Scope Recovery

shots.title: Teach cleanup --stale to pause abandoned running executions with complete scorecard and roadmap evidence (#572)
shots.notes: Workflow cleanup now derives sprint identity from both the persisted sprint_id column and workflow variables, so older or partially populated running executions can still be paused and labeled by sprint.

shots.title: Scope phase-boundary guard away from unrelated Bash commands and abandoned executions (#572)
shots.notes: Phase-boundary now extracts target sprint only from explicit start/run/claim flags or positional ticket IDs, ignores narrative sprint mentions, and covers the front-door `slope start --ticket` command.

shots.title: Make workflow-step-gate recover or fail open with diagnostics for stale validation steps (#572)
shots.notes: workflow-step-gate now fails open when the only running execution does not match current sprint or session context, and true validation-step blocks include cleanup/resync recovery commands.

shots.title: Add store-backed regression coverage for cleanup and guard misfire paths (#572)
shots.notes: Added SQLite-backed regressions proving cleanup pauses all scorecarded roadmap-complete abandoned executions in one pass and workflow-step-gate pauses stale validation executions before they can block edits.

conditions.description: Issue #572 crossed cleanup and guard behavior: abandoned durable workflow executions could survive in the store and then surface as unrelated Bash/Edit blocking.

training.description: Workflow execution sprint identity should be read from all durable sources, not only the newest dedicated column.
training.outcome: cleanup/resync now uses a shared sprint extraction helper that falls back to workflow variables before deciding an execution is unidentifiable.

training.description: Guard selection should require relevance when current sprint context is known.
training.outcome: workflow-step-gate no longer lets a lone stale validation execution override current sprint/session context; it fails open with explicit recovery commands.

nutrition.description: `./node_modules/.bin/vitest.cmd run tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts tests/cli/guards/workflow-step-gate.test.ts tests/cli/guards/phase-boundary.test.ts` passed: 3 files, 53 tests.
Code review and required architect review found no blockers; the shared recovery logic stays centralized in workflow-resync and the guards fail open when context is ambiguous or stale.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A clean recovery sprint: the failure mode was frustrating, but the fix became straightforward once stale store state and guard selection were treated as one workflow problem.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a guard blocks routine work, first ask whether the selected durable execution actually belongs to the current sprint or session.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The single-active fallback was riskier than the multiple-execution case because ambiguity already failed open, while one stale validation execution looked authoritative.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S218 can move into store/bootstrap portability with the workflow guard path less likely to trap recovery work.

bunker_locations: Older workflow execution rows may preserve sprint identity only in variables.sprint_id.
A lone stale validation execution can be more dangerous than multiple stale executions if guard selection treats it as authoritative.
Phase-boundary target parsing should read explicit command targets, not arbitrary narrative sprint mentions.
yardage_book_updates: src/cli/workflow-resync.ts now derives sprint labels from sprint_id or workflow variables and reuses that for cleanup/resync.
src/cli/commands/sprint.ts now prints recovered sprint labels for cleanup and resync output.
src/cli/guards/phase-boundary.ts now parses target sprint from explicit start/run/claim targets and includes front-door `slope start --ticket`.
src/cli/guards/workflow-step-gate.ts now fails open on stale nonmatching executions and includes cleanup/resync diagnostics on true blocks.
tests/cli/sprint-workflow.test.ts, tests/cli/guards/phase-boundary.test.ts, and tests/cli/guards/workflow-step-gate.test.ts cover the #572 cleanup and guard misfire paths.
course_management_notes: GitHub issue #572 is addressed by commits 4f91649, aa1f41b, 43d810a, and 640acb1.
The sprint intentionally leaves unrelated dirty hook and slope-loop files untouched.
Roadmap validation will still warn that S217 is not on main until this branch is merged.
